name: Kithera
tagline: Care coordination that stops falling through the cracks between shifts.
positioning: Kithera is the operational layer for multi-facility elder care — one live record for every resident, so handoffs, meds, and family updates stop getting lost.

hero.h1: Grandma is not a spreadsheet. Stop treating her like one.
hero.sub: Kithera gives every caregiver, nurse, and anxious daughter the same live care record — across facilities, across shifts, across the 2am phone call nobody wants to make.

features.title: Handoffs that survive shift change
features.description: The evening nurse inherits the full picture — not a sticky note that says 'ask Diane.' Care notes, med changes, and flags carry over automatically.

features.title: One record, every facility
features.description: Move a resident from assisted living to memory care without re-keying eight years of history into a new system. It just follows them.

features.title: Family updates on autopilot
features.description: Relatives get a real summary instead of calling the front desk. Fewer angry voicemails, fewer 'why didn't anyone tell us.'

features.title: Escalations that actually escalate
features.description: A missed medication doesn't sit in a queue. Kithera routes it to whoever is on shift and won't stop until a human says they've got it.

features.title: Audit trails compliance will hug you for
features.description: Every change is timestamped and attributed. When the state surveyor shows up, you export a report instead of a panic attack.

features.title: Staffing you can actually see
features.description: Live view of who's on, who's stretched thin, and which wing is one call-out away from chaos.

testimonials.quote: We ran 11 facilities on faxes, three EHRs, and a group text called 'DO NOT DELETE.' Kithera replaced all of it in a quarter. Our surveyor readiness went from a fire drill to a Tuesday.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

testimonials.quote: The family portal alone paid for the contract. Complaint calls to our administrators dropped by half because relatives can just see what's happening.
testimonials.name: Doug Feltner

testimonials.quote: I stopped believing coordination software after the last three. Kithera's handoff feature is the first thing my night nurses didn't quietly abandon.
testimonials.name: Alicia Moreau

pricing.blurb: For single facilities done with faxes and duct-taped spreadsheets.
For multi-site operators who need one record to follow the resident.
For large operators and health systems with real integration needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Kithera keeps elder care coordinated across every shift, facility, and family — so nothing slips through the cracks.
